valid.name: the SMS reference package
valid.toml:
id = "sms-messages"
name = "SMS through your iPhone"
version = "1.0.0"
summary = "Sends a text to your own number through Messages on this Mac."
form = "script"
works = "this_mac"
instructions = "README.md"
requires = { programs = ["/usr/bin/osascript"], permissions = ["automation:com.apple.MobileSMS"] }
reach = { hosts = [], apple_events = ["com.apple.MobileSMS"], files_read = [] }
health = { action = "check" }
tests = { command = ["/bin/zsh", "tests/run.sh"], live = "send_to_me" }

[[settings]]
name = "phone_number"
label = "Your mobile number"
kind = "phone"
required = true

[[actions]]
name = "check"
summary = "See that Messages can send."
class = "read"
run = ["/usr/bin/osascript", "check.applescript"]

[[actions]]
name = "send_to_me"
summary = "Send a text to your own number."
class = "tell_user"
recipient = "user"
undo = ""
run = ["/usr/bin/osascript", "send.applescript"]
timeout_s = 30
input = { type = "object", required = ["text"], properties = { text = { type = "string", maxLength = 600 } } }

[[channels]]
name = "sms"
action = "send_to_me"

valid.name: the GitHub built-in, with a reserved id and a secret its code reads by name
valid.toml:
id = "github"
name = "GitHub"
version = "1"
summary = "Pull requests and reviews on GitHub."
form = "builtin"
works = "any_mac"
reach = { hosts = ["api.github.com", "github.com"] }
health = { action = "check" }

[[secrets]]
name = "token"
label = "GitHub sign-in"
hosts = ["api.github.com"]

[[actions]]
name = "check"
summary = "See that the sign-in works."
class = "read"

[[actions]]
name = "list_pull_requests"
summary = "The open pull requests of a repository."
class = "read"
input = { type = "object", required = ["repo"], properties = { repo = { type = "string" }, state = { type = "string", enum = ["open", "closed", "all"] } } }
output = { type = "array", items = { type = "object", properties = { number = { type = "integer", minimum = 1 }, title = { type = "string", untrusted = true }, url = { type = "string", format = "uri" } } } }

[[actions]]
name = "post_review"
summary = "Post a review with line comments."
class = "speak"
recipient = "input:/pull"
undo = "withdraw_review"
timeout_s = 60
input = { type = "object", required = ["pull", "event"], properties = { pull = { type = "string" }, event = { type = "string", enum = ["COMMENT", "REQUEST_CHANGES"] }, comments = { type = "array", maxItems = 50, items = { type = "object", properties = { path = { type = "string" }, line = { type = "integer", minimum = 1 } } } } } }

[[actions]]
name = "withdraw_review"
summary = "Take a review's comments back."
class = "speak"
recipient = "input:/pull"

[[actions]]
name = "approve_pull_request"
summary = "Approve a pull request."
class = "irreversible"
recipient = "input:/pull"

[[channels]]
name = "github"
action = "post_review"

[[channels]]
name = "github_approve"
action = "approve_pull_request"

[[sources]]
name = "github.pulls"
item = "github.pull_request"
action = "list_pull_requests"
events = ["opened", "updated", "closed"]
interval_s = 300
min_interval_s = 60
facts = { repo = "string", labels = "strings", draft = "bool", size = "number" }
push = { verify = "hmac-sha256", signature_header = "X-Hub-Signature-256", delivery_header = "X-GitHub-Delivery" }

[[candidates]]
item = "github.pull_request"
action = "list_pull_requests"

[[items]]
kind = "github.pull_request"
noun = "pull request"
recognise = ["github\\.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/\\d+"]
